name: designprint
tagline: Pick a template, put your details on it and order prints, from the conversation.
description: Print for AI agents. Shows ready-made templates for business cards, flyers, postcards, posters, brochures, menus, invitations, stationery and tickets, and opens the one you pick in an editor with your details on it. Also makes business cards in the chat and prints a finished design at an exact size. One link to pay as a guest. Ships within the United States.
longDescription: Designprint is a print shop your agent can use. Ask for business cards, a flyer, a menu, a poster, an invitation and more: your agent shows ready-made templates, and the one you pick opens in an editor with your own details already on it. It can also make a two-sided business card from your name and contact details right in the chat, or print a finished design at an exact size. You check it, then pay as a guest from one link. Nothing is printed until you pay. Delivery is within the United States.
prompts: Show me business card templates for a real estate agent
I need a flyer for my Saturday market
Print this poster at 18 x 24 inches and ship it to me
